        • includeAutogeneratedsBL
          boolean includeAutogeneratedsBL
          Whether the autogenerated objects will be initially included in the blacklist (i.e., omitted from any JSON outputs).
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter, or you can use the function inside the filter object.
          An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).
        • includeAutogeneratedsWL
          boolean includeAutogeneratedsWL
          Whether the autogenerated objects will be initially included in the whitelist (i.e., included in any JSON outputs).
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter, or you can use the function inside the filter object.
          An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).
        • includedClassesBL
          Class<?>[] includedClassesBL
          The set of classes initially blocked being outputted to JSON.
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter. An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).
        • includedClassesWL
          Class<?>[] includedClassesWL
          The set of classes allowed to be outputted to JSON.
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter. An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).
        • includedNamesBL
          String[] includedNamesBL
          The initial set of object names, or regex patterns, for which any object whose name matches any one of these will be blocked from being outputted to JSON.
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
          An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).
        • includedNamesWL
          String[] includedNamesWL
          The initial set of object names, or regex patterns, for which any object whose name matches any one of these will be allowed to be outputted to JSON.
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
          An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).
        • includedPackagesBL
          String[] includedPackagesBL
          The initial set of package names, for which any classes belonging to these will be blocked from being outputted to JSON.
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
          An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).
        • includedPackagesWL
          String[] includedPackagesWL
          The initial set of package names, for which any classes belonging to these will be allowed to be outputted to JSON.
          Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
          An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).
        • isBlacklistMode
          boolean isBlacklistMode
          Whether the filter is in blacklist mode (included objects are omitted from the output) or whitelist mode (only included objects will be in the output).
          Calling this parameter's `set_` function will apply the mode and then reset based on the included objects in the other parameters.
        • isCustomConfiguration
          boolean isCustomConfiguration
          Whether to start the filter with empty inclusions or filled with the sets of objects. If empty, being in blacklist mode will try to output everything, while being in whitelist mode will block everything.
          Calling this function's `set_` function and with the custom option enabled (i.e., `true`) will use the values of the parameters; if the empty option is enabled (i.e., `false`) the autogenerated flag will use the blacklist's parameter value and the sets will be cleared.

    • Class com.anylogic.libraries.pypeline.PyCommunicator

      class PyCommunicator extends Jsonifier implements Serializable
      serialVersionUID:
      -9067292034377233487L

      • Serialized Fields

        • _getLevels_xjal
          com.anylogic.engine.markup.Level[] _getLevels_xjal
        • _origin_VA
          com.anylogic.engine.presentation.ViewArea _origin_VA
        • enable
          boolean enable
        • history
          LinkedList<com.anylogic.engine.Pair<String,Attempt>> history
          Holds the last 500 commands ran by the user, in chronological order (i.e., the first item is the most recently run command).

          Implemented as a list of Pair objects with the command as the first value and the Attempt as the second value.

          For example, to get the code used in the most recent command: history.get(0).getFirst()

          And to get the Attempt used in the most recent command: history.get(0).getSecond()



          Provided as reference for the end-user; for example, if they execute multiple commands sequentially and want the outputs without having to create an object for each call.
        • image2
          com.anylogic.engine.presentation.ShapeImage image2
        • level
          com.anylogic.engine.markup.Level level
        • loadLastWorkingConfig
          boolean loadLastWorkingConfig
        • PROPERTIES_FILENAME
          String PROPERTIES_FILENAME
        • pythonCommand
          String pythonCommand
          The full path to the desired python executable.

          The input of this parameter is used when pythonCommandType is set to "(other)" / PythonCommandType.PYTHON_OTHER.

          For other settings, this parameter's value will be updated to reflect the executable path of the active Python being used.
        • pythonCommandType
          PythonCommandType pythonCommandType
          The preferred command to call Python.

          If (other) is selected, you can specify the alias to Python.

          If (path) is selected, you can specify the full path to the desired python executable.
        • pythonExecPath
          String pythonExecPath
          The absolute path to the Python executable that is desired to be connected to.

          The input of this parameter is used when pythonCommandType is set to "(path)" / PythonCommandType.PYTHON_PATH.

          For other settings, this parameter's value will be updated to reflect the executable path of the active Python being used.
        • redirectPyOutput
          boolean redirectPyOutput
          Whether to redirect output coming from Python to the AnyLogic console.

          If true, any print statements or warnings from Python will be printed to the AnyLogic console.

          When viewed from the developer panel, standard output will be printed in green and standard error will be printed in red.

          You may change this parameter during run-time to override the initial value.
        • serverPyLines
          ArrayList<String> serverPyLines
          This file is written in the system's temporary file directory and how Python communicates with AnyLogic.
        • text
          com.anylogic.engine.presentation.ShapeText text
        • throwErrorOnFailedAttempt
          boolean throwErrorOnFailedAttempt
          Decides whether to throw an AnyLogic model error if any command does not execute successfully.

          In other words: if set to true, errors from Python will cause model-halting errors in AnyLogic.
